title: Bizagi FAQs
markdown:
# FAQs

#### Get to know Bizagi.

What does Bizagi stand for?

##### What does Bizagi stand for?

Bizagi (bi-za-jee) is a portmanteau of ‘business’ and ‘agility’.

What year was Bizagi founded?

##### What year was Bizagi founded?

Bizagi was founded in 1989 by CEO Gustavo Gomez.

What is Bizagi’s vision and mission?

##### What is Bizagi’s vision and mission?

Our **vision** is to be the best process automation company, enabling large organizations to change faster.

Our **mission** is to empower people to automate and optimize operations on our cloud-native platform, which is both powerful and easy to use.

Where is Bizagi headquartered?

##### Where is Bizagi headquartered?

[Bizagi’s corporate headquarters](https://www.bizagi.com/en/about/offices "Discover Our Offices Around the Globe | Bizagi") is in Washington DC. We also have offices in Bogota, Madrid, Munich and Buckinghamshire.

Who are Bizagi’s leadership team?

##### Who are Bizagi’s leadership team?

Bizagi is [led by](https://www.bizagi.com/en/about/the-team "Meet Our Leadership Team | Bizagi") CEO Gustavo Gomez and a team of seasoned experts in business orchestration and automation.

What solutions does Bizagi offer?

##### What solutions does Bizagi offer?

Bizagi is a [business orchestration and automation platform](https://www.bizagi.com/en/platform/enterprise-automation "Enterprise Automation Platform | Bizagi") that helps business and IT users automate and orchestrate business processes, connecting people, systems, data, AI and bots.

Who are Bizagi’s main competitors?

##### Who are Bizagi’s main competitors?

Bizagi is an alternative to other enterprise level business orchestration platforms including Appian, Camunda and Pega.

Does Bizagi have a Partner network?

##### Does Bizagi have a Partner network?

Bizagi has [technology and implementation Partners](https://www.bizagi.com/en/resources/partners/find-a-partner "Partner Finder | Bizagi") across regions, including KPMG, Microsoft and YASH Technologies.

What industries does Bizagi operate in?

##### What industries does Bizagi operate in?

Bizagi has [customers across industries](https://www.bizagi.com/en/customers "Process Automation Case Studies | Bizagi") including manufacturing and retail, banking and investments, insurance, government organizations, the energy sector and healthcare.

What deployment options does Bizagi offer?

##### What deployment options does Bizagi offer?

Bizagi deployment is delivered as a Bizagi-managed cloud service on Microsoft Azure, using single-tenant, isolated environments per customer rather than self-managed on-premises or hybrid models.

Is Bizagi a public or private company?

##### Is Bizagi a public or private company?

Bizagi is privately owned.
